outcomes.quote: Do not simply copy and paste the Gen-AI output into ANY assessment submission and hope for the best. The consequence of this could be a charge of academic misconduct; penalties can be severe.
Poor or uncritical application of AI tools may naturally be reflected in lower grades through rubric design, not misconduct proceedings.

definitions.quote: Academic Integrity at Bond means adhering, in words and actions and across all aspects of student life, to an academic moral code bound by the seven integrity principles of honesty, trust, fairness, respect, responsibility, courage, and professionalism.
